episodes.title: Episode One
episodes.summary: Prince Andrew finds himself at the centre of an international scandal. Meanwhile, Emily Maitlis does everything within her power to secure an interview with Prince Andrew to uncover the story.

episodes.title: Episode Two
episodes.summary: Various obstacles stand in the way of the Newsnight interview going ahead. Finally, Emily Maitlis is given the greenlight. But the reality of the interview couldn't be further from what Maitlis expected.

episodes.title: Episode Three
episodes.summary: The interview has far greater consequences than both Prince Andrew and Emily Maitlis ever imagined. Both are left navigating a brave new world in different ways.
